reasons: Section 6.11 is correctly identified as the only audit right binding our party (AbbVie as licensee), and it is limited to books and records — no access to our systems, so nothing approaches walk-away territory.

Material terms meet the preferred position: independent nationally recognized accounting firm designated by Harpoon but reasonably acceptable to us, express frequency cap ('not more than once in any [***] period') plus look-back and repeat limits, disclosure limited to correctness and discrepancy details, and Harpoon bearing cost unless a stated variance threshold is exceeded; Sections 6.12–6.13 and Article 9 add confidentiality and neutral dispute-cost allocation.
The failed 'audit frequency limited' deterministic check is a false negative: the frequency cap exists but the numeric period is redacted as [***], so the regex cannot match a figure.

Absence of an express numeric notice period and the redacted variance percentage are sub-parameters appropriately noted in the rationale as items to confirm against unredacted figures rather than flagged as material failures.
Consistent with a compliant claim, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed, and the rendered redline is identical to the original text — correct handling for retained internal evidence.
